cohort: Mothers aged 20-45 years who had given birth between May 1, 2011, and May 1, 2012, in Hunan Province, China
finding: Prenatal education provided by hospitals in China was associated with higher rates of attending all required prenatal examinations and better recovery from delivery, but not with differences in delivery mode.
mod_finding: While the study found that prenatal education did not significantly impact delivery mode, it did improve prenatal examination attendance and postpartum recovery.
